annotations.title: utilpeek: stablecoin peg check (USDC, USDT, DAI, USDe, PYUSD) from on-chain Uniswap pools, in basis points

description: utilpeek: Check stablecoin peg: is USDC, USDT, DAI, USDe or PYUSD holding its dollar peg. For supply by chain use get_stablecoin_supply. Returns whether USDC, USDT, DAI, USDe or PYUSD holds its dollar peg, from Ethereum Uniswap V3 pools, in `coins`: price, deviation (bps), on_peg / watch / off_peg status (50 and 200 bps), pools and depth, and the read time. Indicative on-chain prices, not an oracle; non-USDC coins are priced in USDC and USDC by cross-check; pools read at most every 30 s; a failed coin is in `errors`; all coins failing is a 502 and an unknown coin a 422 (neither charged). Typically 1 to 4 s (one chain read), under 100 ms when cached. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/stablecoin-peg-check-api.html

coins.description: Stablecoins to check, any of USDC, USDT, DAI, USDe and PYUSD (case does not matter). Omit for all five; an unknown coin is a 422 that lists the supported ones.

name: check_stablecoin_peg

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
